results.name: Plate Wood Chopper
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width, holding a weight plate with both hands.
Start with the plate above one shoulder, arms extended.
Rotate and squat slightly as you bring the plate diagonally down across your body to the outside of the opposite knee.
Reverse the movement back up to the starting position, then switch sides after the set.
tips: Pivot your feet to protect your lower back.
Keep your back flat as you reach down.
results.description: Plate Wood Chopper is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

results.name: Raised Leg Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight, vertical to the floor. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your core and lift your shoulders off the floor, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Lower your shoulders back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; instead, use your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Keep your lower back pressed against the floor to prevent strain and maintain proper form.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
results.description: Raised Leg Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Resistance Band Lying Bent Knee Raise
instructions: Attach the resistance loop band to a low anchor point and lie on your back with your knees bent and feet touching together. Wrap the other end of the loop resistance band over your feet. Place your arms on the floor by your sides.
Keep both legs straight and a few inches off the floor.
Slowly bend your knees and bring your legs up until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and for a 90 degree.
Straighten your legs to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on engaging your abdominals throughout the movement.
Avoid lifting your lower back off the floor; keep it pressed down for the duration of the exercise.
Maintain a slight bend in your knee if necessary to reduce strain.
results.description: Resistance Band Lying Bent Knee Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Reverse Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands on the floor, arms straight, and the ab roller set under your feet. Your legs should be straight back, forming a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and slowly roll the ab roller towards your hands, keeping your legs straight. Continue rolling until your thighs are vertical to the floor.
Hold the position briefly, ensuring your core is tight and your back is straight.
Roll the ab roller back to the starting position with control, maintaining a straight line with your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you roll the roller towards your hands and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Avoid arching your back; maintain a neutral spine to prevent strain on your lower back.
Start with a small range of motion if you are new to this exercise, gradually increasing the distance as you build strength.
Perform the exercise on a stable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and prevent slipping.
results.description: Reverse Ab Wheel Rollout is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Quadriceps.

results.name: Reverse Crunch With Kick Out
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your arms by your sides with palms facing down for stability.
Lift your legs off the floor, bending your knees at a 90-degree angle so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and your calves are parallel to the floor.
Extend your legs straight out in front of you, keeping them off the floor to perform a kick-out.

Bend your knees back to the starting position and engage your core to lift your hips off the floor, curling your knees towards your chest. Lower your hips back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum to lift your hips; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor to avoid straining your neck.
results.description: Reverse Crunch With Kick Out is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your arms by your sides with palms facing down for stability.
Lift your legs off the floor, bending your knees at a 90-degree angle so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and your calves are parallel to the floor.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, curling your knees towards your chest. Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your hips.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position, keeping your knees bent at a 90-degree angle. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum to lift your hips; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them back down.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor to avoid straining your neck.
results.description: Reverse Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Reverse Plank
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your chest open.
Hold the position for the set time, then lower with control.
tips: Don't let your hips drop.
Keep your neck in line with your body; look up rather than letting your head hang back.
results.description: Reverse Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Shoulders, Triceps.

results.name: Russian Twist With Medicine Ball
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels on the ground, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to bring the ball beside one hip.
Rotate back through the centre to the other side and repeat.
tips: Lift your feet to make it harder.
Keep your chest open and turn your shoulders.
results.description: Russian Twist With Medicine Ball is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Lean back slightly so that your torso forms a V-shape with your thighs.
Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing your hands opposite your right hip.
Rotate back through the center and to the left, bringing your hands opposite your left hip. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move your torso, not just your arms, to ensure you are engaging your oblique muscles.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you rotate to each side and inhaling as you return to the center.
Keep your back straight and avoid hunching your shoulders to maintain proper form.
results.description: Russian Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Scissors Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Lift both legs off the floor a few inches, keeping them straight.
Alternately cross your legs over each other in a scissor-like motion. Move your right leg over your left leg and then switch, bringing your left leg over your right leg.
Continue alternating legs in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
tips: Ensure your lower back remains pressed against the floor to avoid strain and maintain proper form.
Move your legs slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
Avoid letting your legs drop too low, which could increase strain on your lower back.
results.description: Scissors Kick is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.
